lines.speaker: atrium_receptionist
lines.text: Visitors sign in. Everyone signs in. The founder signs in and he owns the pen.

lines.speaker: atrium_receptionist
lines.text: The old lab? Back buildings. Nobody has an access reason for those any more; there is a form and nobody has filled it in since I started.

lines.speaker: atrium_receptionist
lines.text: The ticker is allocation figures. I do not know what they mean and neither does anybody on this floor. It is calming, though.

lines.speaker: atrium_receptionist
lines.text: There is a hold on the building today. Something about the senate. Nobody has told me what and I have stopped asking.
